# Simulated key press

Sets or clears a key-matrix bit so the UI task handles it as a real press.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60120327` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Arguments: key code and state (1 = pressed). The shell's ui key skey command reaches it.

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Path from the shell command to the key image read from the code. Source: [Stock Wi-Fi debug shell](../sources/em5n.wifi-shell.md).
